title: Once Upon a Golden Age
theme: Disney's classic animated features from 1937 to 1967
intro: [excited] Dust off the storybook and fluff up your petticoats! Tonight is ONCE UPON A GOLDEN AGE, celebrating Disney classics from Snow White in 1937 all the way to The Jungle Book in 1967. [chuckles] Thirty years of hand-drawn magic, and zero of it is in my hand-drawn handwriting.

art.prompt: Wide 16:9 title card: an enormous leather-bound storybook opening by itself in a candlelit library, golden light spilling out with swirling fairy dust, silhouettes of a glass slipper, a spinning wheel, a poisoned red apple and a wizard's starry hat drifting up from the pages, rich gouache painting No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

categories.title: Mirror, Mirror
categories.intro: [mischievously] Mirror, mirror, on the wall, who knows the most about the fairest film of all? Our film category is 1937's Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: an ornate gilded magic mirror on a stone castle wall glowing green, a shiny red apple on a velvet cushion before it, a dark forest and a tiny cottage reflected in the glass No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: In Snow White, the wicked Queen tricks Snow White into biting a poisoned piece of this fruit.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is an apple! [laughs] Rule number one of fairy tales: never take fruit from a stranger in a cloak.

clues.clue: This dwarf never says a word.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dopey. [chuckles] He does not talk, but those ears say plenty.

clues.clue: The dwarfs sing this song as they march home from the mine.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Heigh-Ho! [excited] It's home from work we go. Nobody has ever been this happy about a commute.

clues.clue: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs premiered in this year, as Disney's first full-length animated feature.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1937. Hollywood called it Disney's Folly. [laughs] It became one of the biggest hits of its time. Folly THAT.

clues.clue: For Snow White, Walt received an honorary Oscar: one full-size statuette plus this many miniature ones.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is seven! [gasps] One big Oscar and seven tiny ones, presented by Shirley Temple in 1939. The cutest trophy ever made.

categories.title: Golden Greats
categories.intro: [excited] This themed category spans the whole golden age. Puppets, pixies, bunnies and cats. Let's GO.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a vintage movie palace marquee glowing at night with golden curtains drawn back to reveal a sparkling sky full of floating story objects: a wooden puppet's tiny hat, pixie dust trails, a bunny-shaped cloud and a pair of teacups No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Pinocchio's nose grows whenever he tells one of these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a lie! [chuckles] Good thing that doesn't happen to game show hosts. My nose would be out the door by now.

clues.clue: This fairy sprinkles pixie dust in the 1953 film Peter Pan.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tinker Bell! [excited] All it takes is faith and trust... and a little bit of pixie dust.

clues.clue: Bambi's rabbit best friend, who thumps his foot.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Thumper. [mischievously] If you can't say something nice, don't say nothing at all. Words to live by.

clues.clue: The pair of troublemaking Siamese cats in 1955's Lady and the Tramp.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Si and Am. [sighs] They wrecked the goldfish bowl and blamed the dog. Classic cats.

clues.clue: The last animated feature Walt Disney personally worked on, released in 1967 after his death.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Jungle Book. [sighs] Walt passed away in December 1966, and the film came out the next fall. What a way to say goodbye.

categories.title: Prop Shop
categories.intro: [excited] Welcome to the Prop Shop! Each picture shows the objects and settings from a golden-age classic. Name the film.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a dusty backstage prop room lit by a single spotlight, shelves of whimsical objects: a glass slipper, a cuckoo clock, a spinning wheel, a wizard's hat, a lantern and a jack-o'-lantern, warm storybook painting No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Name the film.
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cinderella! [laughs] One glass slipper left on the palace steps at midnight. Least practical shoe ever, best plot device ever.

media.prompt: A single sparkling glass slipper resting on a sweeping marble palace staircase at midnight, a giant clock tower glowing in the background and a pumpkin-shaped silhouette rolling away under moonlight. Original illustration, no people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pinocchio. [chuckles] A woodcarver's workshop full of cuckoo clocks? It has to be Geppetto's place.

media.prompt: A cozy Old World woodcarver's workshop at night packed with hand-carved cuckoo clocks and music boxes, wood shavings on a bench, a goldfish bowl on the windowsill and a bright wishing star shining through the window. Original illustration, no people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Name the film.
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: [whispers] The correct answer is Sleeping Beauty. Touch the spindle of a spinning wheel... and down you go. Spooky.

media.prompt: An antique wooden spinning wheel in a dark stone tower room, its spindle glowing with an eerie green light, swirling green mist and thorny vines creeping through a narrow window. Original illustration, no people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Name the film.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Fantasia! The Sorcerer's Apprentice. Never let a broom do your chores. It will NOT stop.

media.prompt: A tall pointed deep-blue wizard's hat decorated with silver stars and crescent moons floating in a flooding stone cellar, wooden buckets and an army of straw brooms marching through the rising water. Original illustration, no people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Name the film.
clues.answer: The Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad
accept: the adventures of ichabod and mr toad
the adventures of ichabod and mr. toad
choices: The Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad, from 1949. [excited] A flaming pumpkin for Sleepy Hollow and a wild motorcar for Mr. Toad. Two stories, one film!

media.prompt: A misty moonlit covered wooden bridge with a glowing, flaming jack-o'-lantern lying in the road, and parked beside it a shiny bright red vintage 1900s motorcar with goggles on the seat. Original illustration, no people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

categories.title: Fantasyland Favorites
categories.intro: [excited] Our parks category is Fantasyland, where the golden-age classics turned into rides. Keep your arms and legs inside the category at all times.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a whimsical fairy-tale village of attraction facades at dusk: giant spinning teacups under paper lanterns, flying elephant ride vehicles with blank sides, a pirate galleon floating above rooftops, glowing string lights No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: On this ride at Disneyland and Magic Kingdom, you soar over London in a flying pirate ship.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Peter Pan's Flight. [laughs] The lines are long... but you get to FLY. Worth it.

clues.clue: This spinning teacup ride is based on 1951's Alice in Wonderland.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Mad Tea Party! [chuckles] Spin that wheel hard. A very merry unbirthday to your stomach.

clues.clue: On this Fantasyland classic, you circle above the park aboard flying elephants.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dumbo the Flying Elephant! [excited] Pro tip: hold the lever all the way up. You deserve the altitude.

clues.clue: Opened in 1955, this Disneyland dark ride lets you drive a motorcar on a madcap journey to nowhere in particular.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Mr. Toad's Wild Ride! Spoiler alert, the ride literally ends somewhere very hot. Wild indeed.

clues.clue: Disneyland's Storybook Land Canal Boats begin their voyage by sailing into the mouth of this whale from Pinocchio.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Monstro! Just like Geppetto, you get swallowed... but these boats sail right back out into miniature fairy-tale villages.

categories.title: Sing-Along Classics
categories.intro: [excited] Warm up those vocal cords! Finish the lyric from a golden-age classic. [chuckles] Singing your answer is optional. Encouraged. But optional.

art.prompt: 16:9 card art: a vintage gramophone horn spilling golden musical notes into a starry night sky over rooftops, sheet music pages fluttering like birds, a wishing star shining bright No people, no recognizable characters, no text or logos.

clues.clue: Finish the lyric from Pinocchio: "When you wish upon a ___"
clues.reveal: The correct answer is star! [sighs] Makes no difference who you are. This one is basically the Disney national anthem.

clues.clue: Finish the lyric from Cinderella: "Salagadoola mechicka boola, Bibbidi-Bobbidi-___"
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Boo! [laughs] Put 'em together and what have you got? A pumpkin carriage and a great answer.

clues.clue: Finish the lyric from Mary Poppins: "Just a spoonful of sugar helps the medicine go ___"
clues.reveal: The correct answer is down! [chuckles] In the most delightful way. Doctors everywhere still have mixed feelings.

clues.clue: Finish the lyric from Sleeping Beauty: "I know you, I walked with you once upon a ___"
clues.reveal: The correct answer is dream! Once Upon a Dream, and the tune comes from Tchaikovsky's ballet. [whispers] Fancy.

clues.clue: Finish the lyric from Lady and the Tramp: "Oh, this is the night, it's a beautiful night, and we call it ___"
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Bella Notte! Sung by Tony and Joe while two dogs share one noodle. Peak romance.
